title: A mistake reads first as a missing guard; a Stop hook spots a mistake told in a reply and its judge files the guard to triage
why: Owner R16, 16:22 and 16:25 CST Nov 10 (relayed by the retrospective session): "...any error they make might be a strong INDICATOR that a guard/something-0mechanical should be in place?"; "yes agreed-- that or we create a hook taht looks for this kind of prose when the session says it so taht way the HOOK/judge files it not the session itself".
note: Rule building-mistake-names-its-guard opens: "Read a mistake first as a missing guard or check, never as a fault to own: the way we work should make accidents hard." Report lines `Cause:` and `Guard:`. Inside the existing Stop hook, no new process: it spots a mistake told in a reply, and its judge files the missing guard to triage. Home: CLAUDE.md building-mistake-names-its-guard; decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner. Plan stage 3.6, commit 88c403ba7.
